gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-tomorrow: Wide-mouthed and hand-drawn, Shantell Sans keeps one fixed nib width throughout, while Tomorrow opens its bowls like a cupped palm. Both stay plain sans in spirit.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-trispace: Shantell Sans has a mouth as wide as a cut tin lid, drawn with one fixed nib width. Trispace follows with sparse, widely set letters, so the heading feels playful and the text feels spacious.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Shantell Sans lets its wide, tin-can mouths and fixed nib width do the talking up top. Tsukimi Rounded keeps going below with round forms like open parentheses, so a long page would feel smooth and unhurried.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-tuffy: A single fixed nib width gives Shantell Sans its wide, expressive mouth and handmade feel up top. Tuffy joins it in pencil-like sans-serif lines with a widely parted s, so the two sit together like a doodle beside a tidy note.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-urbanist: Expressive and wide-mouthed, Shantell Sans draws every stroke with one fixed nib width, while Urbanist trails behind in smooth rolling-ball lines. A long read stays smooth and open.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-varela: Shantell Sans has a wide mouth, like a cut tin lid. Varela sits beneath it in modern sans-serif, with a t whose crossbar and stem share one width, so the heading's handmade swagger gets a friendly, steady companion.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-varela-round: Loose, expressive lettering with a fixed nib and a wide tin-can mouth. Varela Round sits below as a plain sans, framing its counters with same-width strokes, so the heading's playfulness meets a tidier, wide-mouthed text.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-varta: Varta opens every e and a with big, generous eyes, giving the text a contemporary sans feel. And Shantell Sans above it runs a single track width like a neon sign tube, so the pair glows with a lively contrast.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-vazirmatn: Vazirmatn has a wide-open s that never tightens, giving the sans-serif text an approachable, modern ease. And Shantell Sans above it has a blueprint-lettering feel of constant line, so the two feel drawn and relaxed together.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-wix-madefor-disp: Wix Madefor Display reads contemporary, with gently flared curve ends that stay apart. Shantell Sans, bent like a single length of wire, brings the pair its strongest quality: a playful heading over a quietly tidy sans.
